name: kinelia-theme
description: Kinelia Shopify storefront — development tooling manifest only. The theme has no build step; deploys go through the Shopify GitHub integration and the theme editor round-trip.

scripts.lint: shopify theme check --fail-level error && node scripts/check-allowlist.mjs && node scripts/check-secrets.mjs && node scripts/check-tokens.mjs && node scripts/check-seams.mjs
